description: Repository-level evidence registry. Each claim is graded separately from implementation size. Status never auto-upgrades from test count.

statusValues.demonstrated: End-to-end behaviour shown with cited external or internal benchmark and sample.
statusValues.partially-demonstrated: Core path demonstrated; edge cases, scale, or replication not yet shown.
statusValues.internally-benchmarked: Measured on curated or synthetic data by the team; not yet tested with real users or third-party data.
statusValues.infrastructure-only: Plumbing exists (types, schema, fallbacks) but no user-facing behaviour has been exercised.
statusValues.insufficient-evidence: Claim made or implied in copy/site but no measurement exists.
statusValues.externally-validated: Independent replication or audit confirms the claim.

claims.claim: Marks exam answers against the mark scheme accurately without a model.
claims.benchmark: Internal double-marked corpus; agreement vs rubric — no external examiner audit.
claims.limitations: No external examiner blind study; short-answer only; maths/latex equivalence internal.

claims.claim: FSRS scheduler spaces cards effectively for retention.
claims.benchmark: ts-fsrs library; no within-product retention study.
claims.limitations: No human trial; params not calibrated on product data.

claims.claim: Simulator practice transfers to real-world behaviour change.
claims.benchmark: Ledger separates simulator / self-reported / human-rated / validated-transfer; validated-transfer requires adjudicated multi-rater.
claims.limitations: No longitudinal field study; human-rated pipeline exists but has zero external ratings.

claims.claim: Safety gate blocks manipulation, isolation, and distress mishandling deterministically.
claims.benchmark: Pattern suite covering manipulation/isolation/distress; no red-team external audit.
claims.limitations: Regex / heuristic patterns; no third-party adversarial evaluation.

claims.claim: Relationship discovery (correlations → findings) controls confounders and guards causal language.
claims.benchmark: Synthetic data; validateFinding rejects causal language for non-experimental evidence and high-confidence correlation.
claims.limitations: No real user long-term dataset; confounder control not validated against ground truth.

claims.claim: Debate scores derived from observable argument features are consistent across transcripts (invariance).
claims.benchmark: Invariance fixtures; judge output validated via finalizePvpAssessment.
claims.limitations: Synthetic transcripts; no inter-rater agreement against human judges.

claims.claim: Reflection pipeline produces hedged, non-diagnostic summaries with calibrated bias flags.
claims.benchmark: validateSummary rejects unhedged bias language; confidence <0.45 omits flags.
claims.limitations: No user study; no clinician review of hedged language appropriateness.

claims.claim: Progression model prescribes training load accurately (levelled attributes, leakage-safe backtest).
claims.benchmark: Internal backtest with leakage controls; 140 tests in app.
claims.limitations: No training outcome data; not validated against coach prescription.

claims.claim: Filters noisy tool output to ≥60% size reduction while preserving task-relevant information.
claims.benchmark: Corpus builder + families/detection/retention benchmarks; internally curated tool outputs.
claims.limitations: No independent corpus; LLM task success measured on narrow rtk-specific benchmarks.

claims.claim: Household data is isolated by authenticated membership (RLS + RPC) and invitation tokens are not enumerable.
claims.benchmark: RLS policies, membership RPCs, token_hash uniqueness; integration test expects RLS.
claims.limitations: No external pentest; no brute-force rate-limit load test on invitations.

claims.claim: Daily practice improves French speaking/listening fluency.
claims.evidenceSource: apps/french-practice content tests; no user study
claims.limitations: No learner progress study; Groq STT/TTS not benchmarked for correction accuracy.
